inference_protocol.annotation_policy: one photo once; first sorted record per task; AV vessel annotation takes priority; all splits fixed by manifest

metrics.av_decoding: argmax of two conditional logits gated by vessel probability >= threshold; no independent AV class threshold
metrics.evaluation_policy: one photo once; first sorted record per task; AV vessel annotation takes priority; all splits fixed by manifest
metrics.macro_dataset_description: mean supported dataset Dice per channel, then mean available channels; source follows selected annotation bundle

public_export.redactions: physical GPU UUID strings only; full configuration/source/data/scientific counts retained

source.hardware_status: not queried by CPU metadata gate; fresh validation/test producer must log actual device and driver separately
source.source_status: actual package Python source bytes and project metadata; not an in-memory or binary attestation
